newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Banco de Colombia to issue short-term notes.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Colombia to issue short-term notes.

text.p: Banco de Colombia, Colombia's second largest bank in assets, will isssue $120 million of short-term promissory notes in the United States, a bank spokesman said Tuesday.
The funds will be used to finance the bank's short-term credit operations, the spokesman said.
The notes will only be available to specific U.S. investors, including banks and large institutional investors the spokesman said.
Banco de Colombia's first quarter profits fell 63.2 percent compared to the same period last year, partly due to a substantial increase in its past-due loans provisions.
But Colombian brokerage Suvalor SA predicts it will perform strongly for the rest of the year, and expects 1997 operating income to rise by 21 percent over 1996.
